listing.name: Arbworks Ships
listing.summary: A cute little pack of really neatly-sprited ships, most of them asymmetrical. That's about it.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a pack of neatly-sprited, mostly asymmetrical ships with variants and faction entries.

description: Adds a collection of neatly-sprited ships, most of which are asymmetrical. The ships spawn naturally and include variants, as well as entries for SIM, Title, and IndEvo.
